notes_for_us: theme is one string and this build has five looks. A four-era game is a completely ordinary Roblox simulator shape and the handoff cannot say which dressing belongs to which zone; the only reason the eras survived at all is that I wrote them into a free-text image entry.

Nothing can express an option that repeats per zone. This prompt has a shop and a gacha machine in every era, and the emit format has one social-hub row. A P4 build with four zones needs per-zone picks or the zones come back empty.

Simulation has no shape for a base feeding unlockable zones, which is the single most common shape in the whole simulator family. hub-portals from Entertainment fits, but you only reach it by loading the full shape catalogue, and a lane that trusted the typical-shapes line would have forced world-open and lost the portals.

The prompt is Spanish and the era names, currencies and systems are proper nouns in Spanish. I translated the layout content and kept the names; nothing in the skills says which language the handoff speaks.
